User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Remote Agent service listening on TCP port 1234. title: InduSoft Web Studio Remote Agent Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of InduSoft WebStudio. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Remote Agent service listening on TCP port 1234. The issue lies in the lack of authentication, allowing attackers to execute remote API calls on the service. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process.
